title: types: `AnyComponentSchema`'s declaration emit is at 99% of TypeScript's serialization ceiling against objectstack main, so the next spec delta or inline arm hits TS7056 and `@object-ui/types` emits no `.d.ts` (TS7056 family)
body:
Filing gate: **class (a)**, a latent build break with a measured reach. `reach:` **the Spec Main Shape Gate** (the consumer compile against objectstack `main` that the maintainer ruled as the only spec shape gate, objectui#9860, option C). It went red on PR objectui#11570's first head with exactly this failure. Reader: triage grades and routes it.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, seat post objectui#5560). It comes from the objectui#10872 dev's measurement on PR objectui#11570, and the log of the failing gate job 111264389756 was read by this seat. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happened
- PR objectui#11570 (`record:line_items` arm, head `efa2ef2`) went red on `Spec Main Shape Gate` with `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts(593,14): error TS7056: The inferred type of this node exceeds the maximum length the compiler will serialize`. Line 593 is `export const AnyComponentSchema = defineNodeComponentUnion(z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...]))`.
- `@object-ui/types` then emitted no `.d.ts`, and every consumer of `@object-ui/types/zod` failed with TS7016 (cli, core).
- The same gate was green on objectui `main` `ab18797` and on PR objectui#11568's head. Against the published `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 the PR built.
- The PR fixed its own tip at `c9e205d` by giving its arm a NAMED exported type, so declaration emit references it instead of inlining it. The headroom problem stays.

## Measured (the objectui#10872 dev, an instrumented copy of the worktree's TypeScript 6.0.3)
The counter is TypeScript's own `approximateLength`, which it compares with its 1,000,000 `noTruncation` ceiling.

| reading | `AnyComponentSchema` |
|:--|--:|
| objectui `ab18797`, spec 17.6.0-equivalent tree | about 979,997 (fixed head on 17.6.0) |
| objectui `ab18797` against objectstack `main` `5c9138b` | 990,509 |
| + the `record:line_items` arm inline (9,871) | about 1,000,380, which is TS7056 |
| PR objectui#11570's fix (arm named) | 990,574, leaving **9,426 of headroom (0.94%)** |

- The arm's own size is the same on both specs. What moved is the rest of `AnyComponentSchema`: about **+10.6k from spec 17.6.0 to objectstack `main`**, with no objectui change.
- So with no objectui change at all, one more spec delta of that size puts `@object-ui/types` into TS7056 against `main`. So does one new inline arm of 9,426 or more (`record:details` is 5,964, so two such arms). Every objectui PR's `Spec Main Shape Gate` then goes red, and the next spec bump breaks objectui's own Type Check.

## The family (this is its closing card)
TS7056 has already been fixed locally four times, each by naming a type. The docblocks are on objectui `main`:
- `packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts` (about `:766`);
- `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts` (about `:1008`, `ReportNodeZodType`);
- `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` (about `:1401`);
- `packages/types/src/zod/reports.zod.ts` (about `:328`).

PR objectui#11570 is the fifth occurrence. Per the seat's same-family rule, this card covers the whole family, not a single site.

## Likely landing (a lead, not a ruling)
- Name the type of each big category union inside `AnyComponentSchema` (for example `PublicBlockComponentSchema`, about 143.6k on the counter), so its body leaves `AnyComponentSchema`'s print. The types are structurally identical, but the printed `.d.ts` text of existing exports changes, which the PR must state.
- **Enumeration pin (the card's acceptance):** a headroom reading, preferably the gate's own run, that fails when `AnyComponentSchema`'s serialized size crosses a stated margin below the ceiling, with every category union listed as named or inline.
- ⛔ Not a new gate: if a pin is chosen, it is a test in `packages/types` beside the existing union pins.

## Dedupe
- MCP semantic search, repo-scoped: "TS7056 inferred type exceeds maximum length serialize AnyComponentSchema declaration emit" returned objectui#11478, #8784 and #4631, all closed and none about serialization size.
- `git grep TS7056` on `main` finds the four docblocks above and no card.
- Dedupe words: `AnyComponentSchema TS7056 serialization` · `inferred type exceeds maximum length index.zod.ts` · `spec main shape gate declaration emit ceiling`.
